battle_use_tackle.description: Selects FIGHT (slot 1) and then TACKLE (slot 1) to execute a standard physical attack in battle. Automatically inserts a 1.5 second sleep pause to let the move menu load. Do not use if you want to capture the target.
battle_use_tackle.python_script:
import json
# Select FIGHT, then sleep to let the menu transition, then select TACKLE
buttons = ["A", "sleep 1500", "A"]
print(json.dumps(buttons))

history.commit_message: Create reusable battle move selection tool for early-game grinding.

patrol_route2_grass2.description: This tool has been retired as the player is no longer on Route 2.

history.commit_message: Redefined tool to patrol the new northern tall grass patch (TYPE_fed7) starting at (4, 51) with a 4-step loop: (4,51) -> (5,51) -> (5,50) -> (4,50) -> (4,51). Added fallback logic to return to (4,51) if out of bounds.
Updated patrol_route2_grass2 to execute a larger, highly efficient 16-step loop on columns 4-9 and rows 48-51, keeping us 100% on encounter-triggering TYPE_fed7 tall grass tiles.

Fixed patrol_route2_grass2 regression by accessing the global 'input_data' dictionary directly to parse coordinates instead of attempting to read sys.argv[1]. This ensures proper coordinate detection.
Delete patrol_route2_grass2 as it is obsolete.

patrol_forest_grass1.description: Runs a 4-step grass patrol loop on the southernmost grass patch in Viridian Forest: (15,41) -> (14,41) -> (14,40) -> (15,40) -> (15,41). Falls back to navigating to (15,41) if out of bounds.

history.commit_message: Create patrol_forest_grass1 to run a 4-step loop on the southernmost grass patch at (15,41) in Viridian Forest.
